_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: S&P Global 'is a provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, high interest rates, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue; the 10-K names generative AI as a risk to demand for its products (GENAI, on the watch list below)

theme_watch.reason: Live: S&P Global's own FY2024 10-K, under 'The markets in which we operate continuously change to adapt to customer needs. Our inability to innovate and compete with new or enhanced products and services of our competitors could impact our profitability.', says 'Moreover, AI is being used in a way that is significantly increasing access to publicly available free or relatively inexpensive information.' and 'For instance, new competitors are leveraging AI in their offerings in ways that could materially reduce demand for our products and services (for example, by deploying AI in ways that make processing of information relatively inexpensive or free or by leveraging AI to build indices or ETFs).' It builds AI of its own: 'We have made significant investments in various AI initiatives.' The stock trades at 29.4x FY25E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing generative-AI substitution of S&P Global's data, ratings or benchmarks specifically.

classification.quality_note: S&P Global 'is a provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, high interest rates, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue; the 10-K names generative AI as a risk to demand for its products (GENAI, on the watch list below). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.04x; +23% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.44; conservative 2yr +39%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.2%/yr (worst year FY15-FY24, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +14.2%/yr (FY25 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.2%/yr (FY15-FY24 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +22.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY24); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SPGI (retrospective, 2026-02-06) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 1.04x (63.1% downside to Bear $162 / +60.9% upside to Bull $707) | Adj composite 2.54 vs market 2.10: gap +0.44 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +23% above the EPP floor $358 (24x FY25E $14.93) | Conservative 2-yr case: +38.8% total (+19.4%/yr) | At 29.4x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $581 sits at or below the BASE case; Financial Services revenue +9.3% in Q3 2025, forward revenues +7-8% (FY25 revenue guide); generative AI is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
